# Camp Resource: Poisoned Earth Well

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Feb 27, 2025
- 2 min read

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_0858d4f62423443c87b4a820b178e176~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

Even this fouled well can serve a purpose.

Generates Acid, Dirty Water, and Nuclear Waste.

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Poisoned Earth Well__

Image Credit: Nerevar

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_ef6b7e9ac45243a7ae883c2847727823~mv2.jpg)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_9c6ad17f46d04b01b7d694ebc719e861~mv2.jpg)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_0b0c370505b84aeaaaca2bb1c1402fd5~mv2.jpg)

**Produces**

Dirty Water

Acid

Nuclear Waste

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

None

(We both know the wood pile is going to be involved in this again XD)

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Water

**Materials required to craft resource**

1x Rubber

2x Steel

1x Concrete

**Holds**

1 Pound

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - X - X Atoms

Atom Shop - X Bundle - X Atoms

**Produces X amount per**

10 minutes and 12 seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

2 Flamingo Units

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_37a8ee666027440d97d4c2ae0b5393e1~mv2.png)
